verdict.summary: The removed branch is provably unreachable: the provider set and each provider slice are derived from the same post-filter record list using the same provider equality predicate. Removing the guard therefore preserves behavior and makes an invariant violation fail loudly. The added self-test is non-vacuous for provider-processing regressions: it exercises two ordinary providers plus the fleet pseudo-provider and asserts the exact set represented in emitted actions. No fail-open path, weakened trust check, workflow expansion, or security issue is introduced.
